Attention people who only started following cryptos recently:

dogecoin ALWAYS does this. It's super VOLATILE and unpredictable. Goes up a lot, crashes down a lot. Only difference today is that more people know about it, but its not really behaving abnormally in terms of % moves.

dogecoin being a "joke" does not make it worthless as some wrongly assume.

it's a joke to show that cryptos in general don't need much to have value.

their value comes from low supply and is modulated mostly by demand. does not matter what that demand is predicated on.
